user.title: Connect to the Intelbras panel
user.description:
Enter the panel's IP and password. The model (AMT 2018/1016/4010) is detected automatically.

By default, Home Assistant does NOT ask for a code to arm or disarm from the UI — the password below is used automatically behind the scenes, like an already logged-in app. Only check the options below if you want Home Assistant itself to prompt for the password before arming and/or disarming (e.g. if several people share the same Home Assistant and you want to confirm who's touching the alarm).

data.code_required_arm: Ask for the password to ARM via Home Assistant
data.code_required_disarm: Ask for the password to DISARM via Home Assistant

data_description.code_required_arm: Unchecked (default): arms with a single tap, no typing. Checked: asks for the password before arming.
data_description.code_required_disarm: Unchecked (default): disarms with a single tap, no typing. Checked: asks for the password before disarming — recommended if you want an extra lock on this action, the more sensitive of the two.
data_description.enabled_zones: Format: ranges and/or numbers separated by ; (e.g. 1-5;8;10-15). Zones outside this list still exist, just disabled until you enable them manually under Settings → Entities.
data_description.receptor_ip_enabled: Unchecked (default): off, no port is opened. Checked: the panel can connect here and push events in real time — you'll need to configure the panel separately (outside this screen) to point at Home Assistant's IP and the port below. See the README for the full walkthrough.
data_description.receptor_ip_port: Port where Home Assistant will wait for the panel to connect (not to be confused with the panel's own port, above) — must match what's configured on the panel. Only matters if the option above is checked.
data_description.amt8000_mode: Only check this if your panel is an AMT 8000 — it uses a separate protocol still under development and testing (see README_DETALHADO.md, "AMT 8000 (experimental)" section). Leave unchecked for the other models (2018/1016/4010), which keep automatic detection.

partition_passwords.title: Per-partition passwords (optional)
partition_passwords.description: If your 4010 panel has different passwords registered per partition, enter them here. Leave any blank — that partition falls back to the main password from the previous screen. This doesn't replace the 'require code' options: if checked, the value typed in Home Assistant still takes priority.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the panel. Check the IP, port and password.
error.invalid_password: Password must be 4 to 6 numeric digits.
error.invalid_zone_spec: Invalid format. Use ranges and/or numbers separated by ; (e.g. 1-5;8;10-15).

init.title: Configure the Intelbras panel
init.description: Adjust the password, the require-code-in-UI options, and the polling interval — without removing and re-adding the integration. IP, port, the detected model and the default enabled zones aren't editable here (that last one only takes effect during initial setup, before zone entities exist — remove and re-add the integration if you need to change it).
